findings.problem: units here are a measurement of material quantity, not living creatures. viumbe labels resource balances as creatures.
findings.context: MetricCatalog.cpp:274–300,432,443: gathered/stored/spending/delivered/traded and resource growth quantities use this unit key.

findings.problem: mashambulizi means attacks broadly, not projectiles/shots. Accuracy metric counts shots fired/hit.
findings.context: MetricCatalog.cpp:365 shot accuracy; distinguish warrior melee attacks.

findings.problem: Prestige has changed from Heshima in core UI/help to Fahari here, obscuring the same score/victory mechanism.
findings.suggested_correction: Replace Fahari/fahari with Heshima/heshima in this exact value.
findings.context: Match [Prestige], [Prestige Score], [stat prestige], victory controls and relevant tutorial terminology. Both words can be legitimate alone; one glossary term must cover same mechanism.
